audits.resolution_reason: Reviewer-reported exact texture=zero_vector produces a missing color-2 marker and blank Racket label; unknown override keys also accepted. Retain exact source-bound reproductions; audited source not repaired.
audits.text:
## 972c47b94504

**Finding A1 — an advertised exact `texture` value generates an input outside the generator's own contract.** Generator SHA-256 `656c0c13cb8711c52ff581fa8106df604415a20830b855a0f25ce814f9359015`; executed canonical rule hash `54641d07ec65`.

`generate(42, 0, difficulty="medium", texture="zero_vector")` returns a 9×9 grid containing one color-1 marker and **no color-2 marker**. `self_check` rejects it with `expected exactly one 1-marker and one 2-marker, got 1 and 0`, even though `zero_vector` is advertised in `AXES["texture"]["valid"]`. The Racket authority accepts that malformed input and emits an all-zero grid, so this is not merely a validator-message mismatch: the advertised override can inject a degenerate blank-label example into data. The same source also silently accepts an unknown override key; the retained override-stage report fails and records that defect.

Evidence:

- `checks/audit/972c47b94504/metadata.json`
- `checks/audit/972c47b94504/input.json`
- `checks/audit/972c47b94504/racket.json`
- `checks/audit/972c47b94504/override/checks/972c47b94504_before_override.log`
- `checks/audit/972c47b94504/override/DETAIL-COMPACTION.md` (lossless gzip map for the full per-case report)

Racket reproduction from `WORK/`:

```sh
python3 review.py run python3 -m arcpuzzles apply 972c47b94504 \
  --input ../checks/audit/972c47b94504/input.json \
  --out ../checks/audit/972c47b94504/racket.json
```

No audited source was modified.
